youtube.aciklama: The 2019 standard from the World Health Organization and the International Telecommunication Union defines a weekly adult dose equal to 40 hours at 80 dB(A). At a concert averaging 100 dB(A), this budget runs out in about 24 minutes, so a two-hour concert spends about five weeks of budget in one night.

cumleler: How many weeks of listening dose fit into a two-hour concert?
The World Health Organization and the ITU define a weekly dose.
It equals listening at 80 decibels A for 40 hours a week.
Every 3 decibel increase halves the time that fills the same dose.
At 100 decibels A, a week's budget lasts about 24 minutes.
A two-hour concert spends about five weeks of budget in one night.
